tasks.description: Design and implement a passwordless authentication system using magic email links. This system should send a one-time login link to the user's email address. The link should sign the user in when clicked.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid email address, when the user requests a login link, then a one-time login link is sent to the user's email address.
Given a valid one-time login link, when the user clicks the link, then the user is signed in.

tasks.description: Design and implement a login screen with a username field and a button to request a login link. The screen should be accessible, mobile-friendly, and localized.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid email address, when the user enters their email address and requests a login link, then a one-time login link is sent to the user's email address.
Given an invalid email address, when the user enters their email address and requests a login link, then an error message is displayed.

tasks.description: Implement session token expiration after a period of inactivity. The expiration time should be configurable.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user who has been inactive for the expiration time, when the user attempts to access a protected resource, then the user is signed out.
Given a user who has been active, when the user attempts to access a protected resource, then the user is still signed in.

tasks.description: Implement a feature flag to control the rollout of the new authentication system. The flag should be configurable to roll out to a percentage of users.
acceptance_criteria: Given the feature flag is enabled, when a user attempts to log in, then the new authentication system is used.
Given the feature flag is disabled, when a user attempts to log in, then the old authentication system is used.

tasks.description: Implement metrics collection for login success rate and time-to-login. The metrics should be collected for both the old and new authentication systems.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user who logs in successfully, when the metrics are collected, then the login success rate is incremented.
Given a user who logs in, when the metrics are collected, then the time-to-login is recorded.

tasks.description: Remove the password field from the login screen. The password field should not be displayed to the user.
acceptance_criteria: Given the login screen, when the user views the screen, then the password field is not displayed.

tasks.description: Remove the password reset feature. The password reset link should not be displayed to the user.
acceptance_criteria: Given the login screen, when the user views the screen, then the password reset link is not displayed.

tasks.description: Implement localization for the login screen. The screen should be translated into multiple languages.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user who selects a language, when the user views the login screen, then the screen is translated into the selected language.

tasks.description: Implement a mobile-friendly design for the login screen. The screen should be responsive and accessible on mobile devices.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user who views the login screen on a mobile device, when the user interacts with the screen, then the screen is responsive and accessible.
